notes.title: ShipOS 1994 Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]Now Available[/h1]
It has been a long time coming but [b]ShipOS 1994 is now available for purchase on Steam![/b]

Before I say anything else, I really want to [b]thank everyone[/b] from both the Discord server and Steam who have played the demo and provided all of the feedback that they have. Some amazing new features have come from your playtesting so I really appreciate everyone's help!

ShipOS is currently on a [b]launch discount of 15% off[/b] so it's a great time to pick it up and if you do enjoy the game then be sure to leave a review on the store page, it really helps with visibility ːsteamhappyː

If you like the looks of ShipOS but aren't sure if you'd like to commit then be sure to [b]give the demo a try[/b]. It's free and has all the same features as the full game, you're just limited to only playing the first 10 days.

I really hope that everyone who plays ShipOS has a great time. This is the first video game that I've ever publicly released and I honestly couldn't be more excited for you all to try.

Also come and join the [url=https://discord.gg/BGSM9dr689]official Discord[/url] too if you have any feedback or just want to hang out!

notes.title: Automations Update
notes.content:
Automated ship routes have now been added to ShipOS 1994 ahead of its launch on Monday 28th!

Automation has been one of the most requested features to be added to ShipOS since the demo launched a few months back so it's been something I've been working hard on to try have ready in-time for the game's full launch. I've tried to find a nice balance between the game becoming too simple whilst also having automation still simplify your life. So while your ship will now automatically sail from port to port, collecting and dropping off cargo, you will still need to be involved in accepting those cargo contracts and ensuring that your ship is on the most optimal route.

You can try the new automation feature in the ShipOS 1994 demo starting from today!

[h2]Getting started with automations[/h2]
Follow these steps to setup your first automated shipping route:
[olist]
[*] Purchase a ship
[*] Open the Ships application (note: the ship must be delivered to be visible)
[*] Select the ship you want to setup automations for
[*] Select [b]Enabled Automation[/b]
[*] Select the start/end port from the port dropdown and click the [b]+[/b] button to add it
[*] Continue to add as many ports as you'd like to the route (note: only unlocked ports can be added)
[/olist]
And that's it!

[h2]Some things to remember[/h2]
Some important points to remember:
[list]
[*] Your ship will attempt to auto refuel and service at every port it docks at
[*] If a ship is on a long route and runs out of fuel/service you will need to manually refuel/service it and re-enable automations
[*] Ships will only collect accepted contracts so you still need to manually accept them in the Contracts application
[*] Ships will only collect cargo destined for the next port in its route
[/list]

Open to everyone's feedback so feel free to chat in the community forums or over on the [url=https://discord.gg/BGSM9dr689]official Discord server![/url]

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

I am beyond excited to announce that ShipOS 1994 will officially release on [b]28th October 2024[/b]! This marks a major milestone for me personally as it will be the first time I'm releasing a game that I've created on Steam and I can't wait for you all to experience the full journey of running your own shipping company.

In the meantime, you can try out the demo which is available now on Steam. It's a great way to get a feel for the game and see what awaits you in the full version.

Don't forget to wishlist ShipOS 1994 to be notified as soon as the game releases. Your support means the world to me and helps immensely with the game's visibility.

Also, come and join the official [url=https://discord.gg/BGSM9dr689]Discord server[/url]. This is the perfect place to share your thoughts, submit your development ideas, and provide feedback. Your input is invaluable and will help shape the future of ShipOS 1994.

Creating this game has been a labour of love, and I am incredibly proud of the final result. Thank you for being part of this journey. I look forward to seeing you all enjoy the full ShipOS 1994 experience.

notes.title: Demo Now Available
notes.content:
Ahoy, future captains and shipping magnates! We are thrilled to announce that the demo for ShipOS 1994 is now available for you to play on Steam. Dive into the retro-inspired world of maritime strategy and get a taste of what it takes to run a successful shipping company in the 90s.

In ShipOS 1994, you'll manage everything from fleet logistics to financial strategies, navigating the complexities of global trade with the tools and technology of the era. The demo offers a sneak peek into the immersive gameplay and unique challenges that await you in the full game.

As we sail closer to our official launch in the coming months, the demo will be regularly updated with new features, improvements, and bug fixes. Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we encourage everyone to share their thoughts and suggestions. Whether it's through our social media channels or directly on Steam, we want to hear from you!

Join us on this exciting voyage and help shape the final version of ShipOS 1994. Set your course, manage your fleet, and become the ultimate shipping tycoon.

Don't miss out—download the demo today and start your journey on the high seas of ShipOS 1994!

Fair winds and following seas!

notes.title: Public Roadmap Now Live!
notes.content:
It's important to me that core to the development of ShipOS 1994 will always be player feedback. Whether its input on new designs, requests for new features, or identifying pesky bugs, what fans of ShipOS have to say will always be a guiding light in the development of game.

It's therefore important that the development roadmap for ShipOS be widely available for collaboration with the community so I'm excited to announce the launch of the roadmap over on Codecks! 

Link to the roadmap: [url=https://open.codecks.io/shipos1994]Codecks Roadmap[/url]

While light on detail at the minute, my plan is to continue to build out the roadmap to reflect current development efforts. Currently, the feature set for Beta 3 and Beta 4 are live with information on Beta 5 and 6 coming over the course of the next week.

As development progresses you can provide you input at anytime over on the [url=https://discord.gg/BGSM9dr689]Discord server[/url], [url=https://x.com/BorderColGames]Twitter/X[/url], or right here in the community hub on Steam!

Enjoy!
